recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a male musician with a guitar, centered within a thin white rectangular frame, set against a deep black field. The layout features bold, stacked typography at the top and a small tracklist block in the lower right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a secondary internal frame
High-contrast lighting against a void-like black background
Bold, heavy-weight header text contrasting with small, light-weight body text
Primary color palette restricted to black, white, and a single vibrant red accent
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding all elements
Thin white hairline border defining the central image area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, centered, and occupies the lower two-thirds of the internal framed area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright red body of the guitar serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold white header, move down to the subject's face, follow the guitar neck diagonally, and finish at the small text block in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space creates a sense of isolation and focus on the central figure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (Primary header text and framing lines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (Secondary header text and guitar body)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black background; high saturation in the red accent elements.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke widths in the sans-serif elements
Heavy, blocky serifs for the accent text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold white sans-serif paired with bold red slab-serif for high-impact contrast.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, high-impact sans-serif feel of the main header.
Provides the heavy slab-serif structure needed for the secondary header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a male musician with a guitar, lit with dramatic chiascuro against a black background. Place this image inside a thin white rectangular frame centered on a larger black canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold uppercase white sans-serif text at the top of the frame, followed by a horizontal line and bold red slab-serif text. Add a small block of right-aligned white sans-serif text in the bottom right corner of the outer black field.

verificationChecks: Is the subject centered within a white frame?
Is the top text block separated by a horizontal line?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (red could be swapped for yellow or blue)
mustRedesign: Specific song titles in the tracklist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white frame is perfectly rectangular and centered.
Verify the red text is a high-saturation primary red.
Check that the tracklist text is small enough to not compete with the headers.
Confirm the lighting on the subject creates deep shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast framed portrait with stacked, heavy-weight display typography in white and a single accent color against a black void.
